description: Fetch a web page through ScrapeUnblocker and return AI-parsed structured JSON instead of raw HTML (e.g. product details, article content). Best for extracting fields from product, listing or article pages without writing your own HTML parsing. If the page holds no structured data, the result says so (that call is not billed) - use fetch_html for the page itself.

proxy_country.description: Optional ISO country code to route through, e.g. 'US'.

rules_hint.description: Optional natural-language hint about what to extract, to guide parsing.

url.description: The absolute URL to fetch and parse.

name: fetch_parsed
title: Fetch AI-parsed page data
